name: kiems
$comment: Windows (MSVC) libraries for KiEMS, Copper and CSXCAD, used by the windows-msvc-* CMake presets. KiCad itself is not built: on Windows libkicad's stock backend reads boards through an installed KiCad (see submodules/libkicad). macOS and Linux do not use this file. volk and glslang (whose glslangValidator compiles the shaders at build time) are for Copper's Vulkan GPU engine.
